hyperparameters.name: Decision step size L
hyperparameters.context: Time interval between signal control actions

metadata.hardware_requirements: NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 (3.6 GHz, 6 cores). Quote: 'computing server with NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 (3.6 GHz, 6 cores).'

nodes_source.node_name: Real-world traffic data from Qingdao-Huangdao freeway
nodes_source.source_quote: A series of simulation experiments based on real-world traffic data are conducted to evaluate the proposed approach.
nodes_source.description: Empirical traffic volume and driving behavior parameters from the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao in Shandong, China, used to calibrate a microscopic simulation in SUMO.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: The Data Availability section states that the data used to support the results are available from the corresponding author upon request.

nodes_process.source_quote: Vehicle locations are extracted from the traffic video frames and are reformed as position matrices.
nodes_process.description: Extracts vehicle (xi, yi) points into a X by Y position matrix mt. Actions at-1 are encoded in signal positions. N consecutive matrices are stacked to represent temporal dynamics st.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, all processing logic and dimensions specified.

nodes_process.source_quote: A multitask learning strategy is implemented in the training process to improve learning efficiency.
nodes_process.description: Model with 3 CNN layers and dual FC output heads trained using Deep Q-Learning with experience replay and target networks. Minimizes combined loss of Q-values, mean speed, and queue length.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, architecture fully defined, all hyperparameters stated in Table 1.

nodes_process.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator.
nodes_process.description: Simulation comparison of DRL against No-control and PI-ALINEA baselines on a real-world tunnel-connected freeway section using 20 randomized experiments.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, environment specified, tool version missing.

nodes_process.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data.
nodes_process.description: Divide control area into eight subareas and systematically remove sensor information from specific subareas to test impact on travel time metrics.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, logic stated but exact subarea bounds missing from text.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Convergence curves for (a) episode reward and (b) mean travel time.
nodes_sink.description: Graphs showing the episode reward and mean travel time across one million training frames for the proposed DRL agent.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Hyperparameters, reward function, and CNN architecture are fully specified; training time and hardware provided.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Vehicle travel times in the mainline.
nodes_sink.description: Comparison of mainline travel times between no control, PI-ALINEA, and DRL scenarios from 8:00 to 9:00 a.m.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Source data described but not linked; simulation parameters for SUMO are clearly defined for replication.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Mean travel times in 20 simulation experiments (s).
nodes_sink.description: Detailed numeric comparison of mean travel times in seconds and percentage changes across 20 trials for three control methods.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Simulation volume and model parameters provided in Figure 6 and Table 1; outputs directly quantifiable from stated procedures.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Temporal-spatial distribution of speed in (a) no-control; (b) PI-ALINEA; (c) DRL.
nodes_sink.description: Heatmaps displaying speed distribution along a 4000m mainline section over 60 minutes for different metering methods.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Requires dense vehicle log aggregation; spatial segmentation details for heatmap bins are implicit.

nodes_sink.description: Time-series of on-ramp vehicle queue lengths showing interquartile ranges and median for the three scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Definition of queue measurement location clear; results follow from simulation of stated volumes.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Queue length and occupancy for (a) PI-ALINEA and (b) DRL.
nodes_sink.description: Scatter plots with correlation coefficients (rho) illustrating the relationship between mainline occupancy and ramp queue length.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Derivation of correlation relies on model states; specific sampling frequency for the rho calculation is missing.

nodes_sink.description: Box-and-whisker plots of downstream vehicle flow (veh/h) across time intervals comparing no control, PI-ALINEA, and DRL.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Clear alignment with input volumes and evaluation methodology described in Section 4.2.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Travel time with perturbed input data.
nodes_sink.description: Sensitivity analysis of travel times (s) when input data from different road subareas is removed, highlighting model robustness.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Subarea division precisely mapped in Fig 15; logic for removing input signals during evaluation is fully described.
